rows.label: HOCKEY CLINIC
rows.clue: A meeting at which hockey players receive special evaluation and instruction

rows.label: ROUND HAND
rows.clue: A clearly written style of longhand with large round curves

rows.label: ADMONITION
rows.clue: Cautionary advice about something imminent (especially imminent danger or other unpleasantness)

rows.label: ATTESTATION
rows.clue: The action of bearing witness

rows.label: DANCE MUSIC
rows.clue: A genre of popular music composed for ballroom dancing

rows.label: ACCIDENTAL
rows.clue: A musical notation that makes a note sharp or flat or natural although that is not part of the key signature

rows.label: ARROW
rows.clue: A mark to indicate a direction or relation

rows.label: ANSWER
rows.clue: A statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation

rows.label: PALATAL
rows.clue: A semivowel produced with the tongue near the palate (like the initial sound in the English word `yeast')

rows.label: RIGMAROLE
rows.clue: A set of confused and meaningless statements

rows.label: PUNCTILIO
rows.clue: A fine point of etiquette or petty formality

rows.label: TRUE BILL
rows.clue: An indictment endorsed by a grand jury

rows.label: DISRESPECT
rows.clue: An expression of lack of respect

rows.label: MEDIATION
rows.clue: A negotiation to resolve differences that is conducted by some impartial party

rows.label: TITLE PAGE
rows.clue: A page of a book displaying the title and author and publisher

rows.label: DRAWING
rows.clue: An illustration that is drawn by hand and published in a book, magazine, or newspaper

rows.label: NEW CRITICISM
rows.clue: Literary criticism based on close analysis of the text

rows.label: LEGAL OPINION
rows.clue: The legal document stating the reasons for a judicial decision

rows.label: VISUAL JOKE
rows.clue: A joke whose effect is achieved by visual means rather than by speech (as in a movie)

rows.label: MEDAL
rows.clue: An award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event

rows.label: WHISPER
rows.clue: Speaking softly without vibration of the vocal cords

rows.label: FIRE CODE
rows.clue: Set of standards established and enforced by government for fire prevention and safety in case of fire as in fire escapes etc

rows.label: PARADOX
rows.clue: (logic) a statement that contradicts itself

rows.label: TIMELINE
rows.clue: A sequence of related events arranged in chronological order and displayed along a line (usually drawn left to right or top to bottom)

rows.label: WORKSHEET
rows.clue: A sheet of paper with multiple columns

rows.label: NOTEBOOK
rows.clue: A book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda

rows.label: CONSPIRACY
rows.clue: A secret agreement between two or more people to perform an unlawful act

rows.label: DIGRESSION
rows.clue: A message that departs from the main subject

rows.label: CURTSY
rows.clue: Bending the knees

rows.label: AGREEMENT
rows.clue: The statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
